2

Private company research

Private firms do not publish financials — so the agents triangulate from macro data and trend lines instead. Roughly 100–200 new workflows on the same application.

Macro triangulationTrend modeling
3

Document translation

English to Japanese kanji — which breaks layouts in tools like DeepL. NeuralSeek re-translates and reformats decks. The most sensitive documents pull the LLM on-prem, onto GPUs.

English ↔ kanjiOn-prem GPU
